description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthnuwara, Imbulpe D/S/ Division, Ratnapura District (24/1205)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and encumbrances like mortgages. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
